# MXPACKPRO

MXPACKPRO is the international website of Foshan Xumelo Technology Co., Ltd., a custom food packaging supplier based in Foshan, China.

## Core pages
- [Products](https://mxpackpro.com/products): food packaging product categories
- [Custom packaging](https://mxpackpro.com/custom-packaging): custom structure, printing and sampling process
- [Solutions](https://mxpackpro.com/solutions): packaging by food business type
- [Resources](https://mxpackpro.com/resources): packaging buying guides
- [About MXPACKPRO](https://mxpackpro.com/about-us): company and project support
- [FAQ](https://mxpackpro.com/faq): MOQ, artwork, materials, samples and production answers
- [Request a quote](https://mxpackpro.com/get-a-quote): contact and quotation request
